description: Persists a query result into the local RAG cache as a Markdown file. Creates the cache directory if absent. Last step of the RAG chain.

rag_dir.description: Path to the RAG cache directory. Created if it does not exist.

query.description: Original research query, written into the file header

sources.description: List of source URLs or file paths appended as a Sources section

cached_path.description: Full path of the written cache file
